cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX PRO 370 w/ Radeon 890M
build: rustc --edition=2021 -C opt-level=3; uses release dependency rlibs and repository source modules
timing_scope: sequential warm stage probes through frame_at, SVG generation, usvg parse+text shaping, raster, PNG encode, base64; excludes process launch, terminal, disk I/O, pixmap allocation, fontdb initialization and destruction after sampled end
cli_scope: release binary 24-frame export including process startup and output writes; six runs; median of last five; not cold disk-cache measurements
